author: ValWood
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0018242 protein O-linked glycosylation via serine
see  https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29770

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1IPOaUAyQVGQeBC5fTR_eH3Nb4Q1TdrpnbxoZj7Nwc7c/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 

UniProt 15 @Antonialock 
BHF-UCL 4 @RLovering - done
FlyBase 1  @rozaru 


----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 

GO:0018242 | unirule2go | UniRule:UR000165363 > GO:protein O-linked glycosylation via serine ; GO:0018242
GO:0018242 | hamap2go | HAMAP:MF_01472 > GO:protein O-linked glycosylation via serine ; GO:0018242
GO:0018242 | resid2go | RESID:AA0154 > GO:protein O-linked glycosylation via serine ; GO:0018242



Replace with one of these:
| |__protein O-linked mannosylation
| |__protein O-linked GalNAcylation (mucin-type)
| |__protein O-linked fucosylation
| |__protein O-linked glucosylation (NEW)
| |__protein O-linked galactosylation (NEW)

Thanks.
title: Review annotations to  GO:0018242 protein O-linked glycosylation via serine

author: RLovering
body:
Hi Val

I don't think the term protein O-linked GalNAcylation (mucin-type) exists. Is this a new term?

Thanks

Ruth

author: rozaru
body:
Hi Ruth, the term was created to replace ‘core O-glycan biosynthetic process’ which actually represented the O-glycan where the first sugar added is GalNAc. The new term is less common I agree but the reason for the change is that I was trying to have the O-glycosylation classified based on which first sugar is added. 


|__protein O-linked glycosylation 
|   |__protein O-linked mannosylation
|   |__protein O-linked GalNAcylation (mucin-type)
|_      |__core 1 O-glycan biosynthetic process
|_      |__core 2 O-glycan biosynthetic process
|_      |__core 3 O-glycan biosynthetic process
|   |__protein O-linked fucosylation
|   |__protein O-linked GlcNAcylation
|   |__protein O-linked glucosylation (**NEW)**
|   |__protein O-linked arbinosylation **(NEW)**
|   |__protein O-linked xylosylation **(NEW)**
|   |__protein O-linked galactosylation **(NEW)**

I hope it makes sense.

author: RLovering
body: Hi sorry I still don't understand, from your list it looks like there should be a term: protein O-linked GalNAcylation (mucin-type) and a term protein O-linked GlcNAcylation But these are not in QuickGO. BTW it makes it much easier for the curators if you include the GO IDs in these lists so that each curator doesn't have to find the ID to add to the annotation that is being checked, and can easily look at the ontology - see below Thanks for your quick response and sorry for not understanding what the plan is Best Ruth |_ GO:0006493 protein O-linked glycosylation > | |_ GO:0035269 protein O-linked mannosylation ? | |_ GO: ? protein O-linked GalNAcylation (mucin-type) > | |_ GO:0036066 protein O-linked fucosylation > | |_ Also GO:0016266 core O-glycan biosynthetic process >> | |_ GO:0016267 core 1 O-glycan biosynthetic process >> | |_ GO:0016268core 2 O-glycan biosynthetic process >> | |_ GO:0016269 core 3 O-glycan biosynthetic process ? | |_ GO: ? protein O-linked GlcNAcylation ? | |_ protein O-linked glucosylation (NEW) ? | |_ protein O-linked arbinosylation (NEW) ? | |_ protein O-linked xylosylation (NEW) ? | |_ protein O-linked galactosylation (NEW)

author: rozaru
body:
I think Val created / made the changes yesterday and unfortunately they are not available in quickGO/P2G yet.

In bold I added the missing GO ids (I am sorry for not adding them)

GO:0006493 protein O-linked glycosylation

GO:0035269 protein O-linked mannosylation
GO:0036066 protein O-linked fucosylation
**GO:0016266** protein O-linked GalNAcylation
|__GO:0016267 core 1 O-glycan biosynthetic process
|__GO:0016268 core 2 O-glycan biosynthetic process
|__GO:0016269 core 3 O-glycan biosynthetic process
**GO:0180059** protein O-linked glucosylation
**GO:0180063** protein O-linked arbinosylation
**GO:0180064** protein O-linked xylosylation
**GO:0180062** protein O-linked galactosylation

This one 'protein O-linked GlcNAcylation' was not created in the end as it’s a 1 step reaction and is a reversible modification (acts like phosphorylation).

For protein O-linked GalNAcylation (mucin-type) the (mucin-type) part in the name will be deleted.

author: RLovering
body: Thank you again, that is a great help.
